name: Aihio
description: Aihio's design tokens: one set per tier, and a theme modifier for the colours that differ between light and dark. Each token compiles to the CSS custom property --aihio-<its path, joined with hyphens>.

primitive.description: Raw scales with no meaning attached.

semantic.description: What a value is for, the same in both themes.

theme.description: Colour theme. Both contexts define the same colour tokens.
